quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.

dialogue.t: It's fine, I can wait — turnabout is fair play, after all.
You might want to be careful while you deliver it. Don't touch any elements, and don't take too big a step, now.
You do have to be quick about it, though. Wallit's impatience is pretty well-known around here.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogue.t: Come on, why isn't it here yet?

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Yup, Wallit ordered some Fisherman's Toast today before heading off to the Stone Gate on the border between Mondstadt and Liyue.
Really, though, who orders take-out for finger food?
Oh, it's finally here, is it? Thanks so much. Now, pass it to me real quick — I have work to do after this.

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
